project_type: Monorepo: Python FastAPI backend + React/Vite SPA frontend deployed to Cloudflare Pages
build_system: pip-compile for backend deps (requirements.in -> requirements.txt), pnpm for frontend. Build orchestrator at apps/frontend/scripts/build.mjs. Cloudflare Pages builds run the frontend build script.
test_framework: pytest with conftest.py for backend (apps/backend/tests/). vitest for frontend (apps/frontend/). No docker-based testing.
build_command: cd apps/backend && pip install -r requirements.in (dev). cd apps/frontend && pnpm install && pnpm build:client
test_command: cd apps/backend && python -m pytest tests/ (backend). cd apps/frontend && pnpm test (frontend).
verification_instructions: 1. Backend: pip install new deps, verify imports work. 2. Frontend: pnpm install, verify build succeeds. 3. Validate no import errors.
setup_instructions: Backend: cd apps/backend && pip install -r requirements.in. Frontend: cd apps/frontend && pnpm install.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Python 3.11, Node.js 22, pnpm available. No running MongoDB or GCS so tests must be mocked/unit-level.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns: pydantic_settings for config, Beanie ODM for MongoDB models, React Query hooks for frontend data, singleton pattern for services.
key_patterns: Backend services use singleton at module bottom (e.g. content_publisher_service = ContentPublisherService()). Config via pydantic_settings with Optional fields. Frontend fetchers in src/hooks/useContent.jsx. Prerender scripts in apps/frontend/scripts/ use _prerender-data.mjs shared fetch utility. GCS auth via settings.google_credentials property.
directory_structure: apps/backend/app/ - FastAPI app (config.py, models/, services/, api/v1/). apps/backend/tests/ - pytest tests. apps/frontend/src/ - React SPA. apps/frontend/scripts/ - Build/prerender scripts. apps/frontend/public/ - Static assets and Cloudflare config.
